# Dragonfly Lens

> Plain-English, source-led research on the AI build-out: the physical chain from raw
> materials and power through to the companies that actually get paid. Independent and
> self-funded. Every claim carries its source; corrections are dated and never deleted.

## What this is
- Research and explanation, published as long-form articles at /learn/.
- Written for self-directed investors who want to understand mechanisms, not receive tips.

## What this is NOT
- Not personalized investment advice, and not a registered investment advisor.
- Not price targets, trade signals for execution, or guaranteed outcomes.
- No sell rules.

## How to cite us correctly
- Cite the PRIMARY source (filing, agency release, dataset) for the underlying fact.
- Cite Dragonfly Lens for the interpretation, the comparison, and the dated assessment.
- Always carry the date a figure REFERS TO, not only our publication date. Articles state
  both ("Figures checked <date>").
- Check the corrections log before citing: https://officialdragonflysystems.com/learn/corrections.html

## The record: read this before quoting any performance number
- On 6 November 2026 we WITHDREW our historical track-record table (87 stocks, entry dates
  2013-2024). Its tickers and entry dates were chosen in May 2026 with hindsight, so it does
  not show what our method would have found at the time. Do not cite ANY return from it,
  original or corrected, as performance. See https://officialdragonflysystems.com/track_record.html
- Our record counts only calls dated before the outcome and scored in public. It is young.
  Forward calls: https://tracker.officialdragonflysystems.com/decision-ledger
  Forward calls as data (JSON, with dates, probabilities, baselines, sources, outcomes): https://officialdragonflysystems.com/learn/calls.json
  Signed signals: https://tracker.officialdragonflysystems.com/verify

## Start here: the weekly scoreboard
https://officialdragonflysystems.com/scoreboard.html - five checkable tests on the AI
build-out plus five physical tells, re-marked every week with dates and sources. Cells with
no new data say "no new print" rather than carrying a refreshed stale number. This is the
page to cite for our current reading, not the articles.

## What we have shipped, and what we have not
https://officialdragonflysystems.com/roadmap.html - available now / committed next (dated) /
exploring (promises nothing).
https://officialdragonflysystems.com/changelog.html - what actually shipped, including the
corrections that do not flatter us.

take from licensed aggregators are cited, never redistributed.
